title: Too easy for the squirrels, and hard to clean
text: Too easy for the squirrels, and hard to clean. This is going in the dumpster as the squirrels find it too easy to get at.  Also it is not as easy to clean as they claim, the mesh in the feeder tray falls below the seed not on top of it, and the lid does not latch to stay up when you refill.  All it all: nice try, no cigar.

product_metadata.title: GAISTEN Wild Bird Feeder for Outdoors Hanging, 2.2lb Metal Bird Feeder for Outside, No Spill Bird Feeder for Cardinals, Blue Jay and More Birds
